preconditions.description: The length of the genome string n must be between 4 and 255 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', '?'} for c in s)
preconditions.description: The genome string s consists only of characters 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T', or '?'.
The length of the genome string s must exactly match the given integer n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '===' or (all(c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'} for c in stdout) and len(stdout) == n and sum(stdout.count(c) for c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'}) == n and all(stdout.count(c) == n // 4 for c in {'A', 'C', 'G', 'T'}))
postconditions.description: If a valid decoding exists, stdout is a string of length n with no '?' characters, where each of 'A', 'C', 'G', 'T' appears exactly n//4 times. Otherwise, stdout is '==='.
